name: Elemental Gem (Blue Sapphire)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Break the gem
powers.text: Magic action: break it and an Air Elemental appears, friendly to you, for 1 hour.

summary: Break it to summon an Air Elemental that obeys you for an hour.
text: This gem contains a mote of elemental energy. When you take a Magic action to break the gem, an Air Elemental is summoned as if you had cast Conjure Elemental, and the gem's magic is lost. The elemental appears in an unoccupied space as close to the broken gem as possible, is friendly to you and your allies, and obeys your commands for 1 hour or until it drops to 0 Hit Points.
